GRAPH

plot_coefs <- function(model, title, color = "black") {

  coefs <- broom.mixed::tidy(
    model,
    effects = "fixed",
    conf.int = TRUE,
    conf.level = 0.95
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      term = gsub("^Sub", "", term),
      sig = dplyr::case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      )
    )

  ggplot2::ggplot(coefs, ggplot2::aes(x = term, y = estimate)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3, color = color) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
      ggplot2::aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      width = 0.15,
      color = color
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      ggplot2::aes(
        label = sig,
        y = conf.high + 0.05 * max(abs(estimate))
      ),
      vjust = -0.6,
      size = 5,
      color = color
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      x = "",
      y = "Estimate (± 95% CI)"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}
tabla <- function(model_list) {

  tab <- modelsummary(
    model_list,
    output = "data.frame",
    statistics = TRUE,
    stars = TRUE,
    gof_map = c("nobs", "r2.marginal", "r2.conditional", "aic")
  )

  # Transponer
  tab_t <- as.data.frame(t(tab))

  # Usar primera fila como nombres
  colnames(tab_t) <- as.character(tab_t[1, ])

  # Hacer nombres únicos 
  colnames(tab_t) <- make.unique(colnames(tab_t))

  # Eliminar fila usada como header
  tab_t <- tab_t[-1, , drop = FALSE]

  # Guardar nombres de modelo
  tab_t$Modelo <- rownames(tab_t)
  rownames(tab_t) <- NULL

  # Reordenar columnas
  tab_t <- tab_t[, c("Modelo", setdiff(names(tab_t), "Modelo")), drop = FALSE]

  # Exportar a Excel
  # 👉 Capturar nombre del objeto
  nombre_modelo <- deparse(substitute(model_list))
  file_name <- paste0(nombre_modelo, ".xlsx")
  
  write.xlsx(tab_t, file_name, overwrite = TRUE, asTable = TRUE)

  message("✔ Model saved on excel")

  # Retornar tabla para markdown / PDF / HTML
  return(kbl(tab_t, booktabs = TRUE, align = "l"))
}

## Formula: `δ13C (‰ v.s.V-PDB)` ~ N * P + (1 | Bloque)
##    Data: datos_Weinmania
## 
## REML criterion at convergence: 41.3
## 
## Scaled residuals: 
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -1.3591 -0.6595 -0.1032  0.5990  1.9534 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups   Name        Variance Std.Dev.
##  Bloque   (Intercept) 0.07414  0.2723  
##  Residual             0.69473  0.8335  
## Number of obs: 18, groups:  Bloque, 3
## 
## Fixed effects:
##             Estimate Std. Error       df t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept) -27.7240     0.4061   7.9349 -68.275 2.82e-12 ***
## N            -0.3457     0.5305  12.1611  -0.652    0.527    
## P            -0.6130     0.5087  12.3443  -1.205    0.251    
## N:P          -0.2528     0.8627  11.8078  -0.293    0.775    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##     (Intr) N      P     
## N   -0.653              
## P   -0.679  0.516       
## N:P  0.397 -0.612 -0.574
mod_Ci_pt <- lmer(Ci ~ N*P + (1 | Bloque), data = datos_Pouteria)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
mod_Ci_cr <- lmer(Ci ~ N*P + (1 | Bloque), data = datos_Clarisia)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
mod_Ci_al <- lmer(Ci ~ N*P + (1 | Bloque), data = datos_al)
mod_Ci_my <- lmer(Ci~ N*P + (1 | Bloque), data = datos_myrcia)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
mod_Ci_hp <- lmer(Ci~ N*P + (1 | Bloque), data = datos_hp)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
mod_Ci_wl <- lmer(Ci ~ N*P + (1 | Bloque), data = datos_Weinmania)

1.2. Diagnostico

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))  # 4 modelos por página

for (name in names(models_iWUE)) {
  m <- models_iWUE[[name]]
  r <- resid(m)
  f <- fitted(m)
  
  # 1. Residuales vs Fitted
  plot(f, r,
       main = paste(name, "- Residuals"),
       xlab = "Fitted values",
       ylab = "Residuals")
  abline(h = 0, col = "red")
  
  # 2. QQ plot
  qqnorm(r, main = paste(name, "- QQ plot"))
  qqline(r, col = "red")
}

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))  # 4 modelos por página

for (name in names(models_est)) {
  m <- models_est[[name]]
  r <- resid(m)
  f <- fitted(m)
  
  # 1. Residuales vs Fitted
  plot(f, r,
       main = paste(name, "- Residuals"),
       xlab = "Fitted values",
       ylab = "Residuals")
  abline(h = 0, col = "red")
  
  # 2. QQ plot
  qqnorm(r, main = paste(name, "- QQ plot"))
  qqline(r, col = "red")
}
